doc.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010

title: Louis Armstrong and Charlie Parker as the two innovators
summary: He credits Pops with starting the music and Bird with cleaning it up and changing everything.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: But that’s the way that is, but you know as things move on I always felt, and even then, since the beginning of Louis Armstrong, because nothing, definitely he was the forerunner, you’ve got to say that. And then I’ll say Charlie Parker, check him out, Charlie Parker’s okay. Now let me expand it. So Pops got it started, Bird got it cleaned up and changed everything. You know what I’m saying?
